englishmc.create.help: Offline speaking practice for this single-player world. Uses your Windows microphone when you press the record key.
englishmc.create.difficulty_help: A1 and A2 cover basic interaction. B1 and B2 cover everyday conversations. CET-4 and CET-6 focus on speaking tasks, and IELTS 6–7 on developing ideas.
englishmc.status.retry: Try the example or give a fuller on-topic reply  ·  %2$s Retry
englishmc.status.mic_unavailable: Check your default Windows microphone and privacy permission  ·  %2$s Retry
englishmc.status.voice_failed: Offline neural voice failed. Check audio output, then replay the prompt.
englishmc.status.unsupported: Microphone and speech playback require 64-bit Windows.
englishmc.roleplay.title: %1$s · Turn %2$s/%3$s
englishmc.roleplay.task.A1.2: Use a few simple words to answer.
englishmc.roleplay.task.A1.3: Say one short sentence to finish.
englishmc.roleplay.task.A2.1: Give your answer and add one detail.
englishmc.roleplay.task.A2.2: Give one useful detail about what you need.
englishmc.roleplay.task.B1.1: Answer in your own words and add a useful detail.
englishmc.roleplay.task.B1.2: Explain your choice or ask a follow-up question.
englishmc.roleplay.task.B1.3: Agree on the next step or offer an alternative.
englishmc.roleplay.task.B2.1: State what you need and explain why it matters.
englishmc.roleplay.task.B2.2: Address the new detail and suggest a workable option.
englishmc.roleplay.task.B2.3: Confirm the plan and say what you'd do if it changes.
englishmc.roleplay.task.CET4.1: Give a brief, clear statement in two connected sentences.
englishmc.roleplay.task.CET4.2: Explain one reason and respond to the other person.
englishmc.roleplay.task.CET4.3: Summarize your decision and close politely.
englishmc.roleplay.task.CET6.1: Start with the relevant constraint, then state your position.
englishmc.roleplay.task.CET6.2: Handle the other person's concern and propose a practical option.
englishmc.roleplay.task.CET6.3: State the agreement, then give a fallback.
englishmc.roleplay.task.IELTS_6_7.1: Develop your reply with a reason and a specific detail.
englishmc.roleplay.task.IELTS_6_7.2: Explain what would change your answer or what you would do instead.
englishmc.roleplay.task.IELTS_6_7.3: Close the exchange and explain when your plan might change.
